description.cn: 雅库伯尔和呼临的战争终于休止，芙和马尔科也迎来了他们之间爱情的结局。

physical_summary_i18n.en: A Wildborn man named Bium calls Halians cruel, blaming them for the suffering of his kin and the loss of the Hunting Goddess' favor. If a Wildborn fell in love with a Halian, he says, they should be cast out.
